links.outcome: Agreement between AI and surgeon annotations of safety milestones on local videos
links.effect: AI-surgeon agreement was 98-100% for four milestones. For distance from esophagus ≥1 cm, true agreement was 100% but false agreement was 13.6% (kappa 0.2, p=0.006).
links.quote: Outcomes suggest its accuracy in four of five safety milestone annotations.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation study assessing the accuracy of a computer vision AI platform for surgical video annotation of safety milestones in sleeve gastrectomy compared to surgeon evaluation.
